scope: 2018-2020 discovery only; matched source event clocks
interpretation: fee versus residual price/share accounting, and action-version contrast on same event; not model alpha or causal feature effect

calculation.scope_filter: trade_date year <=2020; fixed version status paired_funded; 2021/22 economic columns not accessed
calculation.event_join: one_to_one on trade_date and bar_end_at between two verified Qlib label Recorders
calculation.year_aggregation: first average each metric by trade_date over its minute events; then mean those daily values within each year
calculation.common_version_delta: on old paired_funded intersection, fixed relative value minus old relative value; aggregate by day then year
calculation.new_only: fixed paired_funded but old no_exact_whole_share_pair; day mean then year mean
